title: Cartwise Rewards Move Rates for Cartwise+ Membership Moves to Monthly
content:
When a Cartwise+ Membership moves from Cartwise+ Annual to Cartwise+ Monthly on a pause request, the move rate applied to Cartwise+ Monthly's period fee follows the member's Cartwise Rewards tier.

| Member's Cartwise Rewards tier | Move rate |
|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 0.9 |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver or Bronze | 0.95 |
| any other tier, or no Cartwise Rewards account | no rate set under this table |

The tier is the one the member's Cartwise Rewards account shows today. The rate multiplies Cartwise+ Monthly's period fee of 9.99.

## Hypothetical illustrations

| Tier | Monthly fee at the tier's rate |
|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Gold | 9.99 multiplied by 0.9 is 8.991 |
| Cartwise Rewards Bronze | 9.99 multiplied by 0.95 is 9.4905 |
| Cartwise Rewards Member | no rate set under this table |
